newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile economic growth on target - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Chile economic growth on target - central bank.

text.p: Figures showing that Chile's economy grew 5.7 percent in August, which were higher than expected by analysts, are within official targets, said Central Bank President Carlos Massad.
The Imacec index showed a situation of growth in production and demand which is in-line with the bank forecasts, Massad told a meeting of manufacturing exporters.

Chilean stocks opened lower on news of the August data which showed economic growth was stronger than the bolsa was anticipating. Investors had been expecting growth to slow to between 4.7 and five percent.
The bank said in its fortnightly report that August's growth was influenced in large measure by expansion in the mining, construction and transport and telecommunication sectors.
